'''Ishla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Quesh war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]], she was stationed at the [[Imperial Garrison (Quesh)|Imperial Garrison]], where she shared her experience and knowledge with other [[Sith Warrior]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Ishla appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a class trainer for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Warrior class on Quesh.<ref name="TOR" />
